output.reason: The CRD diffs [ev-fb4370b76542][ev-4cfdef775223][ev-6aaf9d482a51][ev-50d874fa9a77] add spec.emitWarning as a boolean defaulting to false on both ClusterPolicy and Policy (v1 and v2beta1). The described effect, API response warnings plus longer admission processing, applies only when the field is enabled. The release note [ev-e47234304fa3] also presents it as an opt-in policy setting. So the only environments that touch this change are those with a ClusterPolicy or Policy that sets spec.emitWarning to true, which is what the proposed any-of-two-resources condition expresses. Matching on group and kind without a version correctly covers both API versions, while the gvk-in-use alternatives (P2, P3) would flag every policy user even though nothing changes for them.
